text: ぼくたちの　まけだ　うえには　うえが　いるものだな

structure.jp: ぼくたちの　まけだ
うえには　うえが　いるものだな
structure.en: there really is always someone better, huh

patterns.name: 〜ものだ
patterns.explanation: ものだ after a verb says 'that's just the way the world is', with feeling. いるものだな = 'there really is one, isn't there'.

patterns.name: 〜な (feeling)
patterns.explanation: な at the end shows the speaker is musing with feeling, half to himself. ものだな = 'so that's how it is, huh'.
